arStrings.szText: {c_important}Forceful Arrow{/c} now Immobilizes Knocked Back enemies for {c_number}{buffduration:IMMOBILIZE}{/c} |4second:seconds; and deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_A_IMPACT}{/c} damage. {c_important}Forceful Arrow's{/c} Knock Back range is increased by {c_number}[{SF_28}*100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Forceful Arrow{/c} pierces through the first enemy hit, deals {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_IMPACT}{/c} damage, and has a {c_number}[SF_29 * 100|%|]{/c} chance to {c_important}{u}Execute{/u}{/c} enemies.

{c_important}Forceful Arrow's{/c} Propel no longer Knocks Back Close enemies and instead creates an {c_important}{u}Arrow Storm{/u}{/c} every {c_number}{SF_31}{/c} arrows, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_C_DAMAGE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage and Slowing enemies hit by {c_number}[{SF_21}*100|%|]{/c} for {c_number}{buffduration:SLOW}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Forceful Arrow{/c} causes enemies to become {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} seconds.
Gain {c_number}{SF_30}{/c} Energy when {c_important}Forceful Arrow{/c} damages an enemy and an additional {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} Energy after attempting to Propel an enemy.
{c_important}Forceful Arrow{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} stacks of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c} after attempting to Propel an enemy.
{c_important}Forceful Arrow{/c} grants {c_number}{SF_34}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} after attempting to Propel an enemy.
